title: Teleoperation test run record (LiveKit Rust SDK)
description: One record per run, written as JSONL to runs/<suite>.jsonl. The conditions block and the metrics block MUST travel together: a metrics blob without the conditions that produced it is unanalyzable, and that is the single most common way a test matrix rots. Requested and actual are both first-class — a cell labelled av1 that silently fell back to another codec is the worst data point this matrix can produce, and this schema exists to catch it. Field authority: docs/MEASUREMENT-DESIGN.md §11.

run_id.description: Stable unique id: <suite>__<cell_id>__r<repeat_index>__<epoch>. Deterministic prefix so repeats of one cell group by string prefix.

cell_id.description: Comma-joined swept axis assignments, e.g. 'video_codec=av1,buffering_mode=zero_jitter'. Identifies the cell across repeats.

repeat_index.description: 0-based. >=3 repeats per cell (matrix.yaml meta.parameters.default_repeats). A single run of a noisy link proves nothing; a breakpoint whose repeats disagree is reported as a range, not a point.

tier.description: 0 = MacBook, live SFU, no shaping. 1 = Linux host with root and netem (the full matrix). 2 = external camera and NVENC-class GPU. A reader must never have to guess which tier produced a number.

conditions.description: The independent variables AS APPLIED, not as requested. netem clamps and shapers round; store the real value and the verbatim tc command. Every axis in matrix.yaml appears here, including the ones the suite held at their default — a held value is still a condition.

video_codec_requested.description: H265 is excluded from the matrix: it is the one codec with an automatic fallback (publisher.rs:1210-1224), so an h265 cell silently becomes an h264 cell.

video_codec_actual.description: Negotiated codec, parsed from RtcStats::Codec.mime_type joined via stream.codec_id. THE ANALYSIS USES THIS ONE. Mismatch against requested ⇒ INVALID (codec_fallback), never a FAIL. Null only when no codec stat was ever observed, which is itself an INVALID condition.

codec_mismatch.description: video_codec_actual != video_codec_requested. Materialized rather than left for the reader to derive, so a grep for bad cells is one field away.

buffering_mode.description: PROCESS-GLOBAL. enable_zero_playout_delay mutates LK_RUNTIME and errors if the runtime is already up without it (lk_runtime.rs:39-49); it cannot be toggled per room or subscriber within one process. Cross-check against harness.subscriber_process_id: a zero_jitter run that shared a process with another mode is not a zero_jitter run. The room-level playout-delay HINT modes (playout_hint_floor, playout_hint_smooth) are RETIRED — see matrix.yaml buffering_mode.retired_values. Records written before that change carry those values and are not schema-valid against this revision; that is deliberate, so an old run cannot be silently pooled with a new one.

playout_delay_min_ms.description: Milliseconds, quantized to 10 ms steps rounded down. Always null now: zero_jitter does not go through the room API. Retained so records that predate the hint retirement still parse and so the field is unambiguous rather than absent.

audio_buffering.description: A RECORDED FACT, not a setting the harness applies. No Rust API in this checkout configures the audio jitter buffer, so audio runs at the SDK default under every buffering_mode INCLUDING zero_jitter. Present so a reader of a zero_jitter run cannot infer audio was also unbuffered.

control_transport.description: T-2 depends entirely on this — the transports have opposite failure signatures under loss. Never leave it implicit.

control_buffer_size.description: Frame count, not a duration (remote/mod.rs:215-221). SDK default is 16; the reference config sets 1. Null for the legacy dc_* paths.

control_rate_hz.description: PRD §7.2 mocap sample rate. Held at 200; it is the load, not a variable.

playout_window_ms.description: The application deadline control_late_pct is computed against. Null when the suite does not model one — control_late_pct is then unmeasurable and must be null, not zero.

video_width_actual.description: OutboundRtp.frame_width. The SDK may downscale under quality_limitation_reason: Bandwidth — the §7.1c behavior T-1 is measuring. T-1 scores on ACTUAL.

simulcast.description: Fixed off for the core matrix; changes bitrate behavior substantially.

audio_source.description: Synthetic by default: a microphone makes audio_level environment-dependent and the runs non-reproducible.

loss_pct.description: As applied by netem, read back from tc qdisc show — not as requested.

netem_cmd.description: The verbatim single tc command applied. ONE qdisc command per cell: delay, jitter and loss combine into a single `tc qdisc replace`, because two separate netem commands silently replace each other. Null when no shaping was applied (Tier 0).

tbf_cmd.description: Rate limiting is a SEPARATE tbf qdisc, layered deliberately on top of netem. Never merged into netem_cmd.

tc_qdisc_show.description: Verbatim `tc qdisc show` output captured POST-APPLY. This is the record of what the kernel actually did, as distinct from what was asked for.

shaping_applied.description: False on Tier 0. If false while any shaping axis sits at a non-default value, the run is INVALID — that combination means a requested condition was silently not applied.

environment.description: Everything needed to decide whether two runs are comparable. The analysis never pools across video_codec, encoder_tier, buffering_mode, control_transport, ran_profile, or path.

path.description: Loopback and lan results do NOT transfer to cellular. Tag it or the report misleads.

encoder_tier.description: RECORDED, NEVER REQUESTED — selection is automatic. Classified from encoder_implementation and power_efficient_encoder. Apple Silicon has no AV1 hardware encoder, so --codec av1 on a MacBook is tier sw: its bitrate efficiency is representative, its encode latency, CPU load and fps ceiling are NOT. A breakpoint derived from software AV1 is labelled as such wherever it appears.

encoder_requested.description: Held at auto for the whole matrix; forcing a backend would measure a configuration no robot runs.

encoder_implementation.description: OutboundRtp.encoder_implementation from the ACTIVE layer (selection rule: publisher.rs:406-424). Picking an arbitrary OutboundRtp gives the wrong layer.

power_efficient_encoder.description: libwebrtc's own hw/sw signal; corroborates encoder_tier.

ran_profile.description: RECORDED, NEVER SET BY THE HARNESS. Five settings owned by the T-Mobile network team. On path loopback or lan every field is 'n/a' and the report must state those results do not transfer to cellular. The report may never compare across profiles without saying so.

camera_source.description: Resolved video source: 'test_pattern' (the default for every matrix cell) or the device name the harness actually opened. Overwritten from the run_metadata record, so it is what ran rather than what was requested. A never_pool_across dimension: a lens makes bitrate depend on scene content, lighting and framing, so camera and pattern runs are different experiments and are never aggregated.

camera_device.description: The capture device a camera run resolved to, and the format it negotiated. Null for 'test_pattern'. The negotiated geometry is recorded because a device is free to downgrade a request, and a run that got 720p15 instead of 1080p30 presented the encoder with a different problem that nothing downstream could otherwise detect.

device_name.description: Human-readable device name. The portable identifier of the two.

device_index.description: Enumeration-order index. Positional, so it names a different camera on a different host.

negotiated_format.description: e.g. 'YUYV' or 'MJPEG'. MJPEG adds a decode step YUYV does not.

load_generator_hosts.description: T-4 only. MUST be distinct from host_id: if generator and probe share a NIC, poll_overbudget_pct rises and client saturation is misattributed to SFU saturation.

build_config.description: Debug builds blow the poll budget. Never mix build configs in one report.

clock_source.description: Gates whether one-way numbers mean anything.

harness.description: How the measurement itself was configured. Every field here is one an analysis-side derivation depends on and would be silently wrong without.

video_poll_hz.description: Keyframe service time is QUANTIZED TO THIS. T-2 commits to 10 Hz; every other suite is 1 Hz. A reader must never have to infer the resolution — keyframe_service_polls is reported in poll intervals, and this field is what converts them to a time bound.

stats_poll_hz.description: RtcStats poll cadence for everything other than the video track.

warmup_excluded_s.description: Leading seconds discarded before any metric is computed. Rate windows need time to fill; including warmup biases every rate low. Sourced from matrix.yaml, recorded here so the exclusion is auditable rather than assumed.

poll_overbudget_multiplier.description: A poll is overbudget when actual_interval > this x nominal. Harness-derived, sourced from matrix.yaml — recorded so a threshold change is traceable and never becomes a magic number in Python.

subscriber_process_id.description: PROVES THE PROCESS-PER-BUFFERING-MODE GROUPING HELD. enable_zero_playout_delay is process-global, so a zero_jitter run sharing a process id with a run at another buffering_mode is not a zero_jitter run and must be discarded. The analysis checks this; it is not decoration.

scored_window_start_unix_us.description: Post-warmup window bounds. The control_delivered_pct denominator is defined against these.

playout_units_confirmed.description: RETIRED, always null. Was the design §4 units gate, which disambiguated whether create_room_with_playout_delay took milliseconds or 10 ms units. With the playout-hint buffering modes retired the harness never calls that API, so there is no unit to confirm — moot by construction, not unresolved. Retained so pre-retirement records still parse. Re-adding any hint mode must restore the gate.

publisher_seq_log.description: Path to the publisher-side log of every emitted seq with its send timestamp. THE control_delivered_pct DENOMINATOR. Without it the metric must be null, not estimated from received sequence numbers — deriving the denominator as max_seq-min_seq+1 is self-referential and biased toward passing, because loss at a window edge shrinks the denominator by exactly the number lost and becomes invisible.

g2g_timing_handler_installed.description: Whether every video subscription got its receive-side packet trailer handler installed. False means frames arrived with no capture timestamp for at least one subscription, so g2g_metadata_coverage_pct is structurally incomplete rather than merely low. The handler is created lazily and needs the track's transceiver, and subscribe_timing_events() reports no error when it installs nothing — see docs/SDK-FINDINGS.md. Null for records written before the harness recorded this.

video_subscription_count.description: Remote video subscriptions established over the run. Greater than one means the session re-subscribed mid-run, which is what a full reconnect (not a resume) does; the G2G series then spans two subscriptions. Distinguishes a full restart from a transport resume, which reconnect_count alone does not. Null for records written before the harness recorded this.

harness_cmd.description: Verbatim argv of the harness invocation.

metrics.description: Flat map of metric name (keys must exist in matrix.yaml `metrics`) to value. A metric that was not measured is null — never 0, which is a measurement. Cumulative counters are differenced before any ratio; every name carries its unit suffix.

distributions.description: Metrics whose answer is a shape, not a scalar. keyframe_service_polls lives here: it is reported as a distribution of POLL INTERVALS plus the observed maximum, never as a millisecond percentile, because the measurement resolution equals the poll period and a p95 over a handful of quantized values is just the maximum wearing a percentile's name.

events.description: Session lifecycle timeline for T-5. A survived reconnect is NOT a drop — §8.6b explicitly permits it, and scoring reconnects as session_drops would fail runs the PRD passes.

harness_initiated.description: Harness-initiated closes are excluded from session_drops.

raw.description: Pointers to bulk artifacts, not the artifacts themselves — keeps the JSONL small enough to grep.

snapshots_jsonl_path.description: Per-poll stats snapshots for the whole run: the timeseries behind every summarized metric. Differencing happens analysis-side, so a bug in it is fixable without re-running the matrix.

video_sample_path.description: T-1 only: recorded footage per rung, for Figure's manipulation judgment.

validity.description: Whether this run counts. A run can be INVALID without being a FAIL, and conflating the two is how a matrix produces confident wrong answers. A run that did not measure the thing is excluded from every breakpoint, never counted as a failure.

invalid_reasons.description: Controlled vocabulary only — a free-text reason is not analyzable. Must match matrix.yaml `invalid_reasons`.

invalid_detail.description: Human-readable elaboration, parallel to invalid_reasons. e.g. 'codec_fallback: requested av1, negotiated vp9'.

clock_sync_confidence.description: Gates whether any one-way figure may be published at all. `none` suppresses the OWD and G2G columns; the run remains VALID for RTT and video metrics.

theta_ms.description: Clock offset estimate. Paired by construction: min of the OWD ring at probe completion, minus the RTT OF THAT SAME probe exchange, halved. Independently-selected window minima absorb path drift as if it were clock offset.

theta_residual_bound_ms.description: The (d_in - d_out)/2 residual on asymmetric links — which cellular is. Corrected OWD is never presented as exact.

g2g_metadata_coverage_pct.description: frames_with_metadata / frames_received * 100. Required whenever video was subscribed. Below 95 the run is INVALID with reason g2g_metadata_missing: subscribe_timing_events() was called after NativeVideoStream was constructed, so frame_metadata arrived empty for every frame. Every other signal — fps, freeze counts, InboundRtp counters — looks healthy in that state, which is why this field must travel with the record rather than be inferred from a null g2g. It distinguishes 'G2G genuinely unmeasurable on this path' from 'the ordering was wrong'; both present as g2g: None and only one is a valid result.

samples_scored.description: Post-warmup sample count actually used. A run below a metric's minimum-sample precondition yields null for that metric.

verdict.description: Filled by parse_runs.py, never by the harness. Four-way, not three-way.

status.description: OBSERVE is not a weaker PASS. Audio metrics score OBSERVE because total_playout_delay measures only the playout-side share of the PRD's mouth-to-ear budget; forcing a blocking verdict on a proxy that measures less than the clause describes is exactly the failure this category exists to prevent.

provenance.description: Carried into the verdict so a report never states a harness-derived number as a requirement. blocking != PRD MUST.

observed.description: Rows with effect: observe, reported with their measured value and the boundary of what the proxy excludes.

delta_from_reference.description: Every result is reported as a delta from reference_config. Null on the baseline cell itself, and null across any never_pool_across boundary — a delta computed against a different codec or encoder tier is not a delta, it is two experiments subtracted.
